rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for cooking food in boiling water.

example.english: We boil some vegetables in boiling water.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 gwan2 seoi2 zyu2 di1 coi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for boiling food such as eggs in water, rather than for general cooking.

example.english: I usually boil two eggs for breakfast.
example.traditional: 朝早我通常烚兩隻蛋做早餐。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 hap6 loeng5 zek3 daan6 zou6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this for boiling water, especially when saying that you will boil the kettle.

example.english: I’m going to boil water now, then have tea.
example.traditional: 我而家去煲水，陣間飲茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 bou1 seoi2 zan6 gaan1 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing heating a liquid until it reaches boiling point.

example.english: The water hasn’t boiled yet, so I’ll boil it a little longer first.
example.traditional: 水未滾，我再煲滾多陣先。
example.jyutping: seoi2 mei6 gwan2 ngo5 zoi3 bou1 gwan2 do1 zan6 sin1
